title: SauceDemo observed behavior and accessibility test plan

requirements.description: Provisional observed behavior: supplied public test-account listings and named login controls are available; submitting standard_user without a password displays the observed password-required alert.
Provisional observed behavior: blank login submission displays the observed username-required alert.
Provisional observed behavior: invalid credentials display the observed mismatch alert.
Provisional observed behavior: locked_out_user displays the observed locked-out alert.
Provisional observed behavior: standard_user sees six inventory products and the observed sort choices and orderings.
Provisional observed behavior: inventory detail controls and Backpack detail display the supplied observed content.
Provisional observed behavior: adding/removing Backpack updates its control and cart accessible name.
Provisional observed behavior: cart shows the selected item and the supplied controls.
Provisional observed behavior: checkout information form, individually observed missing First Name, Last Name, and Postal Code alerts, and supplied valid-data route transition.
Provisional observed behavior: checkout overview displays supplied item, payment, shipping, and totals.
Provisional observed behavior: Finish displays the supplied completion copy and empty cart.
Provisional observed behavior: menu/footer names, About URL, and Logout return route are as supplied.

Project test scope: automated axe-core scans cover login, inventory, cart, and checkout; manual keyboard and screen-reader reviews are documented separately. No scan or manual review result is claimed.

scope: Use verified SauceDemo observations as provisional acceptance criteria for this demo automation project, not formal product-owner guarantees. Cover login, inventory visibility/sorting, Backpack details, cart, checkout, menu/logout navigation, automated axe-core scans on login/inventory/cart/checkout, and separately documented manual keyboard/screen-reader checks. No accessibility scan or manual conformance result is claimed. API behavior, browser/OS matrix, non-Backpack detail variations, and other unobserved validation outcomes are out of scope.
environment: Named Playwright environment: PLAYWRIGHT_ENV=saucedemo, base URL https://www.saucedemo.com/. Browser build/version is externally managed and not observed. Each Playwright test must use its own default isolated browser context/page, sign in and establish its own preconditions, and must not reuse storageState or cart state from another test. Cart scenarios sign in as standard_user, add only their required item, and verify the expected cart state. When a cart must begin empty, use the observed inventory menu Reset App State action and assert the accessible cart name is Cart, empty before arranging scenario data. Supplied demo credentials are standard_user / secret_sauce and locked_out_user / secret_sauce; checkout sample data is Ada / Lovelace / 12345. Evidence source: integrated browser page and browser interactions; configured Playwright MCP was unavailable and was not used. No axe scan was run.

projectDecisions.decision: For this demo automation project, the verified browser observations recorded in this plan are provisional acceptance oracles. They are not represented as formal SauceDemo business requirements or guarantees across app releases.
projectDecisions.basis: Explicit project-scope decision supplied by the requester.

projectDecisions.decision: Plan automated axe-core scans for login, inventory, cart, checkout information, checkout overview, and checkout completion. Record axe violations by rule, impact, target, and route; do not claim zero violations or WCAG conformance before scans are run and an acceptance threshold is approved.
projectDecisions.basis: Explicit accessibility scope supplied by the requester.

projectDecisions.decision: Document manual keyboard and screen-reader checks separately from axe automation; manual review results must identify the browser and assistive technology actually exercised.
projectDecisions.basis: Explicit accessibility scope supplied by the requester.

projectDecisions.decision: Use isolated Playwright browser contexts per test with independent login and precondition setup. For cart scenarios, reset through the observed Reset App State menu action, assert Cart, empty, then add only scenario-required products. Do not share authentication storage or depend on another test's cart.
projectDecisions.basis: Project test-isolation policy; the Reset App State action was observed to clear a non-empty cart.

projectDecisions.decision: Preserve all 20 original scenario IDs and add two separate checkout cases for the newly observed missing Last Name and missing Postal Code errors, bringing the draft to 22 cases.
projectDecisions.basis: Browser evidence verified two distinct validation responses that were not represented by the original 20 cases.

scenarios.description: Sign in with the supplied standard_user credentials and reach the observed inventory page.

Verify the public accepted-user listing contains standard_user and locked_out_user and the public password listing says secret_sauce.

expectedResults: The user reaches /inventory.html.
The page heading is Products and six products are displayed.

automation.approach: UI flow using accessible form controls and observable route/heading/product count.
automation.rationale: No SauceDemo generator kind exists; implement only after plan approval and generator support.

Each product exposes the supplied product-name button naming pattern and product-specific Add to cart control.

scenarios.description: Verify Name (A to Z) and Name (Z to A) produce the supplied product orders.
preconditions: Signed in as standard_user / secret_sauce and viewing inventory.
steps: Select Name (A to Z) from the Sort products combobox.
Record the visible product order.
Select Name (Z to A) and record the visible product order.
expectedResults: The combobox is named Sort products and includes Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), and Price (high to low).
A to Z order is Backpack, Bike Light, Bolt T-Shirt, Fleece Jacket, Onesie, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red).
Z to A order is the inverse: Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red), Onesie, Fleece Jacket, Bolt T-Shirt, Bike Light, Backpack.

automation.approach: UI sorting assertions against complete observed name sequences.
automation.rationale: No SauceDemo generator kind exists.

scenarios.description: Verify both price sort directions against the supplied observed product and price sequences.
preconditions: Signed in as standard_user / secret_sauce and viewing inventory.
steps: Select Price (low to high) from Sort products.
Record product names and displayed prices in order.
Select Price (high to low) and record product names in order.
expectedResults: Low to high is Onesie ($7.99), Bike Light ($9.99), Bolt T-Shirt ($15.99), Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) ($15.99), Backpack ($29.99), Fleece Jacket ($49.99).
High to low names are Fleece Jacket, Backpack, Bolt T-Shirt, Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red), Bike Light, Onesie.
The supplied observations establish the equal-price ordering only for low-to-high; high-to-low tie order is not asserted.

automation.approach: UI sort assertions against supplied values; avoid asserting unspecified tie behavior in descending direction.
automation.rationale: No SauceDemo generator kind exists.

scenarios.description: Run and document automated axe-core scans on login, inventory, cart, and checkout states.
preconditions: The named SauceDemo environment is available.
A signed-out login page and signed-in inventory, cart, checkout information, overview, and completion states can be reached using supplied demo data.
steps: Run @axe-core/playwright on login, inventory, cart, checkout information, checkout overview, and completion states using WCAG 2.2 AA tags.
Record scan configuration, page/state, violations by rule/impact/target, and triage disposition.
expectedResults: Automated findings are recorded by page and rule; no zero-violation outcome or WCAG conformance is claimed before the scans run.
No scan has been run yet; observed results and any agreed severity thresholds are documented separately.

automation.approach: Separate axe-core scans on each planned page state; report findings without presuming a zero-violation oracle.
automation.rationale: The scan scope is an explicit project decision; no axe scan was run during browser exploration.
